cs.t: I tried a high end Philips one and a Nest camera. Both were  way  less reliable than the Nanit. Possibly because they didn’t play nicely with my mesh WiFi at home. But regardless I just wanted to vouch for Nanit’s software, whatever they are doing with their networking and UX is really good.
cs.th: We saved $500k per year by rolling our own "S3"
